weeds.speaker: A neighbor
weeds.text: That plot's been weeds since spring. Clear it if you want. I won't start it for you.

offer.speaker: A neighbor
offer.text: You got the weeds out. I've got seed in the shed, if you want a second pair of hands.

planted.speaker: A neighbor
planted.text: It's in the ground. Give it a couple of mornings. Don't hover.
add_notes: The community garden on Maple Lane is planted.

later.speaker: A neighbor
later.text: Seed keeps. The soil doesn't mind waiting a day.

growing.speaker: A neighbor
growing.text: The garden's started. I'll water if I'm out this way. You don't have to schedule me.
